reason: The cited evidence (E1, E2) shows graphene arresting cracks in a different HEA system (CoCrFeNi films) under micro-compression, supporting the crack-arrest premise, but provides no support for the other key premises regarding conformal coating on bulk alloys, preservation of caloric response, specific strength improvements, or durability under cyclic loading.
premises: Graphene can arrest crack propagation in a metallic matrix
Graphene coating can be applied conformally and continuously to a bulk alloy surface
Ultrathin graphene does not disrupt bulk phase transitions or caloric response
Graphene improves compressive strength of a composite by 30-50%
Graphene coating remains intact under cyclic field and mechanical loading
